label: Preference-independent epistemic…: Ordinary epistemic favoring whose pro tanto normative force…
definition: Ordinary epistemic favoring whose pro tanto normative force does not depend on the subject desiring accuracy or the favored answer, with the relevant evidence and circumstances fixed. Pro tanto force can be outweighed; preference independence does not entail agent-neutrality, an overriding duty, factivity, infallible access or ontological irreducibility.
